description: Deep-drawn metal bearing cup: outer flange (rolled edge), a stepped inner rim/collar, and a central bore. Photographed top-down (rim visible as a ring) or tilted (side view, rim foreshortened).

identity.summary: A round, deep-drawn metal CUP: circular outer flange/rolled edge, a stepped inner rim/collar, and a central bore. Roughly circular silhouette, not an elongated strap.
distinguishing_features: round / circular silhouette (top-down) or shallow cylinder (tilted)
concentric rings: outer flange, inner rim/collar, central bore
cup-like depth (a drawn wall), not a flat thin plate
no in-line row of holes and no serrated hole
not_to_confuse_with: bracket (a flat elongated strap with 3 in-line holes and a serrated hole, NOT a round cup)

missing_punch.signature: The central bore/hole is absent - the piercing/punching operation was missed, leaving a solid blind face where a through-hole should be. Critical, highest priority.

out_of_round.signature: Central bore is not a clean circle - one side pinched, dented inward or ovalised (out-of-round).
disambiguation: ALWAYS assess bore roundness even on tilted/side-view cups.
Trace the bore opening: a good bore is a SMOOTH closed curve (a true circle head-on, a smooth ELLIPSE when tilted - perspective foreshortening alone is NOT a defect).
Flag out_of_round ONLY when the outline has a LOCALISED break in that smooth curve - one side flattened, pinched inward, or straightened so the arc is no longer smooth.
Distinguish from perspective: a tilted circle still curves smoothly everywhere; an out-of-round bore has a visible flat/kink on one segment.
Put a TIGHT bbox on the pinched/flattened segment, not the whole bore.

rulings: Scan the ENTIRE part for EVERY applicable defect - outer edge, inner rim, both flanges and faces. Never stop at the first finding.
Capture MULTIPLE defects per image and rank them; mark the highest-severity one as PRIMARY.
Tilted / side-view cups whose inner rim is smooth and not clearly visible are OK - do NOT paint a speculative box; a false mark is worse than none.
For small rim/edge features use a TIGHT bbox on the actual defect, not the whole rim arc.
notes: Missing/sheared material at the rim -> edge_chip. Metal pushed in but intact -> dent. Central hole not punched -> missing_punch. Rust/stain -> corrosion.
